dataset.help_text: Select the biomedical knowledge graph dataset to generate predictions for.

embeddings.help_text: Select which embedding models to use for predictions. By default all 4 models are run.

env.help_text: 'prod' runs all terms. 'test' limits to 2 terms per embedding for quick validation.

sample.help_text: When true, randomly sample 10,000 terms (seed=42) for faster processing. Set to false to process all terms.

outdir.help_text: The output directory where results will be published. Can be a local path or S3 URI.

s3_embeddings_base.description: S3 base path for upstream embedding artifacts.
s3_embeddings_base.help_text: Base S3 path where trained models and training triples are stored. Models are resolved at {base}/{dataset}/{embedding}/trained_model.pkl.
